dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...The analysis results are in. The low-frequency waves emitted by that body are no longer Ungie's groans; they are... a kind of warning signal..."

dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...The messenger bearing this warning — the Stellar Blackbody... fused within Ungie — is the entity carrying out this function..."
